text: Refines D-0343 for #608, step 4 of #571's statechart plan: Invariant draws a checked ordinary reader chart itself, as SVG, through one shared renderer, (*statechart.Result).SVG(), which receipts and the dashboard reuse beside the factory's Mermaid. The SVG draws every chart state, initial state and visible labeled arrow, including self-loops, parallel and reverse arrows, with literal multiline labels. It also shows the report: the checked bounds, the rules' exact wording, violations, unavailable actions, every hidden occurrence, independent counts and their meanings, provenance and temporal trace facts, adding no proof claim. It embeds the full Result as inert JSON metadata, is deterministic and accessible, and carries no scripts, event handlers, foreign content or external resources, so no Mermaid, Graphviz or other rendering program runs when a person views it. A malformed chart, or text XML can't represent, returns an error and no SVG. Layout isn't part of this contract, so it can improve without changing it; #613 proposes a layered layout.
